notes.title: SkyTime v1.1.1

- New level selection system and menu
- New progress saving system
	- This unfortunately resets all your current in-game progress

- Full Controller Support!

notes.title: SkyTime v1.1
notes.content:
- Updated end goal particles to green to make it more visible
- Updated Speed Run level
- Updated tutorial level
- Added countdown timer to levels that are time based
- Readjusted wrench to make it better:
  1. Wrench flies faster
  2. Wrench flies a bit further
  3. When hitting anything except a turret, wrench bounces off and continues, instead of wandering around and being useless
- Added 'R' as a quick restart button
- Killing a turret now rewards with a little time energy
- Increased turret hitbox size
- Fixed double throw problem when double clicking to throw wrench
- Remapped wrench recall ability from F to left mouse click when wrench is not in hand
- Reduce energy cost of wrench recall to 15%
- Added a particle effect to show when the recall ability is used on the wrench

notes.title: SkyTime v1.0.3
notes.content:
- (Hopefully) Fixed Wrench coming back instantly when throwing it
- Fixed crosshair to the center of the screen (It was slightly off)
- Fixed volume slider in pause menu
- Increased the amount of velocity you store after jumping from a moving platform
- Made bullets more visible to the eye
- Increased the size of the completion trigger in the tutorial level
- Updated tutorial message to make it more clear that time slow is toggleable
- Improved platform explosion
- Increased player ground detection radius for a bit more wiggle room when jumping
- Added a new level: Speed Run
- Added new achievements: Destroy all turrets in Speed Run and Complete Speed Run within 92 seconds

notes.title: SkyTime v1.0.2
notes.content:
- Updated Frog like experience lighting
- Changed recall ability to only cost 30% energy instead of 50%
- Repositioned Round about time first lane platforms to make for an easier run in the beginning
- Made the trailer in the main menu not be affected by lights
- Made the main menu always scale with the current game resolution, meaning it should always look the same
- Added refresh rate display to resolution menu
- Fixed resolution selection menu
- Fixed FPS Displayer
- Fixed resolution box twitching in options menu
- Repositioned level completion in Public transport to meet the path of the vehicle
- Increase player jump speed to allow for slightly higher jumps
- Decreased the speed of the platforms in Fast and Chill to allow for more time to complete the level
- Increased wrench collider size to allow for easier shots
- Increase wrench speed and range for faster gameplay
- Made the explosion particles last half as long
- Updated Public Transport level start and end messages
- Fixed Quit to Desktop button
- Made platforms keep their initial rotation when spawning
- Updated Bullet Rain lighting
- Added hand motion when moving
- Made watch hand idle execute more frequently
- Updated Public Transport Mission Sign
- Readjusted position of hands and camera
- Increased FOV to 75
- Updated end goal graphics
- Updated tutorial level
- Add Invert Mouse option to Main Menu
- Fixed glass window collider
- Removed paused black screen at the beginning of the tutorial
- Added save file migration from TeamA1 to Six Bobs

Known issues:
- Wrench sometimes instantly comes back when being thrown
- Building colliders aren't perfect

notes.title: SkyTime v1.0.1
notes.content:
- Updated company name to Six Bobs (Formerly known as Team A1)
- Added version to the main menu
- Changed sliding - When walking, Dr. Deevon will now stop almost immediately.
- Updated the Public Transport level to be more guiding towards the goal
- Added a visual indicator of where the level ends
- Updated level lighting
- Readjusted turret placement towards the end of the Round About Time level to make for an easier triple kill at the right angle
- Repositioned turrets in Fast and Chill to make it a bit easier to get the achievement
- Repositioned spawn point in Bullet Rain to prevent almost instant death to unprepared players
- Fixed "Fat Wrench" bug (thanks to KevGueey)
- Added the ability for the player to climb small distances when hitting a wall

Known issues:
- Wrench sometimes instantly comes back when being thrown
- Building colliders aren't perfect
- Explosion particles stay for a bit too long and it affects vision
